items.title: 「斷崖式」下滑！OPEC 8月日產量暴跌90萬桶 沙烏地出口驟減三分之一
items.title_en: "Cliff‑like" Drop! OPEC’s August Daily Production Plummets by 900,000 Barrels, Saudi Exports Slashed by One‑Third
paras: 外媒調查：OPEC 8月日產量暴跌90萬桶 沙烏地阿拉伯出口銳減三分之一
根據彭博調查，受中東衝突升級及原油運輸受阻影響，OPEC今年8月原油日產量大減約90萬桶，降至平均每天1,991萬桶，結束6、7月供應逐步恢復的勢頭。其中，沙烏地阿拉伯產量與出口雙雙大幅下滑，供應鏈風險持續推升油價逼近每桶100美元。
彭博最新產量調查綜合船舶追蹤資料與官方資訊，並參考Rapidan Energy Group、FGE NexantECA、Kpler Ltd.及Rystad Energy AS等能源顧問機構的估算模型。結果顯示，OPEC在今年6月與7月原本透過努力維持海上原油運輸，使實際供應逐步回升，但中東衝突升溫後，8月產量出現明顯逆轉。
作為OPEC實際領導者，沙烏地阿拉伯受到的衝擊尤其嚴重。彭博與Kpler、Vortexa整理的初步船舶追蹤資料顯示，沙烏地阿拉伯8月原油日產量驟減112萬桶至698萬桶，創今年5月以來最低水準；原油日出口量更較前月大減約三分之一，只剩303萬桶。
供應大幅萎縮與沙烏地阿拉伯兩大出口路線同時面臨安全風險有關。美國與伊朗持續數月的軍事衝突尚未透過外交途徑化解，波斯灣船舶運輸受到攻擊及威脅，荷姆茲海峽的原油運輸因此受到嚴重干擾。近期油輪通行量雖未完全中斷，但已明顯低於正常水準，能源市場仍持續面臨供應風險。
紅海方面，胡塞組織持續對沙烏地阿拉伯及相關航運發動攻擊，進一步壓縮沙國利用紅海出口原油的替代空間。9月8日，胡塞組織宣稱對沙烏地阿拉伯南部多座城市及能源設施發動攻擊，沙烏地方面表示共有73人受傷，部分能源設施起火並一度停擺，市場對中東供應中斷的疑慮因此進一步升溫。
供應鏈持續承壓也成為油價上漲的重要推手。布蘭特原油近期一度升至每桶97.92美元，創約6周新高，美國西德州中級原油(WTI)也升至93美元上方。不過，市場目前仍未突破每桶100美元，主要受到部分海灣產油國改用替代出口路線、非OPEC產油國增產，以及全球需求放緩等因素制約。
在沙烏地阿拉伯產量大幅下降之際，伊拉克與委內瑞拉的增產則抵銷部分OPEC整體跌幅。彭博調查顯示，伊拉克8月原油日產量增加27萬桶至298萬桶。另一方面，委內瑞拉日產量增加7萬桶至123萬桶，創約7年新高。
伊拉克的實際出口同樣明顯回升。路透報導指出，伊拉克8月原油出口量由7月約135萬桶/日升至約234萬桶/日，主要受到出口折價、買家需求回升，以及部分油輪獲准通過荷姆茲海峽等因素帶動。伊拉克國營石油銷售公司SOMO甚至提供每桶約25至30美元的折價，以吸引中國、印度及其他大型買家。
然而，委內瑞拉的增產反而凸顯OPEC內部正在浮現的政治裂痕。彭博此前報導，委內瑞拉正認真評估退出OPEC的可能性，相關議題已成為委內瑞拉與美國官員討論的一部分，目前尚未做出最終決定。
美國總統川普近期也表示，委內瑞拉是否退出OPEC由該國自行決定。與此同時，美國對委內瑞拉能源產業的影響力持續擴大。川普透露，美國已取得進入委內瑞拉17座油田的協議，這些油田擁有約640億桶探明石油儲量，若全面開發，對美國供應的潛在增量最高可達每天150萬桶；Exxon Mobil(XOM-US)與Chevron(CVX-US)等美國大型石油公司也被川普點名可能參與投資。
委內瑞拉若最終退出，將是OPEC繼阿聯酋今年5月離開後，數月內再度面臨重要成員可能出走的局面。市場人士認為，委內瑞拉本身的短期供應影響可能有限，但若再加上伊拉克對配額的不滿，將進一步削弱由沙烏地阿拉伯主導的OPEC維持內部團結與影響油價的能力。
面對供應受阻及組織內部裂痕，OPEC+核心成員已決定暫緩進一步增加產量。7個主要成員沙烏地阿拉伯、俄羅斯、伊拉克、科威特、哈薩克、阿爾及利亞與阿曼9月6日召開線上會議後，同意維持10月產量政策不變，也就是以9月既定產量水準作為10月要求產量。OPEC官方表示，下一次會議將於10月4日舉行。
這項決定意味著OPEC+在連續6個月提高產量後暫時踩下煞車。7個核心成員8月原本同意9月增加約18.8萬桶/日，完成逐步撤回2023年推出的165萬桶/日自願減產措施。然而，實際產量仍明顯落後於紙面配額，因為荷姆茲海峽運輸受阻及俄羅斯等地的供應問題，使提高產量目標並不等於實際原油能夠抵達市場。
路透指出，OPEC+目前對實體原油市場的影響力已受到戰爭及物流瓶頸限制。即使產油國提高配額，也無法保證新增原油能夠實際生產並運往消費市場，因此市場焦點已逐漸從短期月度增產轉向2027年產量配額的重新分配。
OPEC+目前也正進行成員國最大可持續產能的審查，以建立2027年新的產量基準。德州顧問公司DeGolyer and MacNaughton負責多數成員的產能評估，報告預計在9月底前提交OPEC，之後各國將進入新一輪配額談判。OPEC此前已確認，完成最大可持續產能評估是制定2027年產量基準的重要依據。
這場產能審查可能成為OPEC+下一階段最具爭議的議題。伊拉克等成員已要求提高配額，以反映自身產能增加；阿聯酋則曾因認為既有配額無法反映其不斷上升的產能而最終退出OPEC。若委內瑞拉也選擇離開，OPEC內部對配額、公平性及市場策略的分歧恐進一步擴大。
因此，在紙面產量政策逐步解除減產、實際供應卻因戰事與運輸瓶頸大幅下降的矛盾下，OPEC+正面臨前所未有的政策困境。即使聯盟已完成部分2023年減產措施的撤回，產油國能否將名義產能轉化為真正可出口的原油，仍取決於荷姆茲海峽、紅海及其他能源運輸路線的安全情勢。
目前市場關注焦點也從「OPEC+是否增產」轉向「新增產能究竟能否送達市場」。在中東衝突仍未出現明確降溫訊號的情況下，任何新的油輪襲擊、出口設施受損或荷姆茲海峽運輸進一步受阻，都可能迅速放大供應缺口，讓布蘭特原油重新挑戰每桶100美元關卡。
paras_en: Foreign media investigation: OPEC’s August daily production plunged by 900,000 barrels, Saudi Arabia’s exports sharply cut by one‑third

According to Bloomberg’s survey, the escalation of the Middle‑East conflict and disruptions to oil transport caused OPEC’s daily crude output in August to fall by about 900,000 barrels, down to an average of 19.91 million barrels per day, ending the gradual supply recovery seen in June and July. Saudi Arabia’s production and exports both fell sharply, keeping supply‑chain risks high and pushing oil prices toward $100 a barrel.

Bloomberg’s latest production estimate combines vessel‑tracking data with official information and incorporates models from energy consultancies such as Rapidan Energy Group, FGE NexantECA, Kpler Ltd. and Rystad Energy AS. The results show that OPEC had managed to restore some offshore crude flows in June and July, but after the conflict heated up, August production reversed sharply.

As the de‑facto leader of OPEC, Saudi Arabia was hit especially hard. Preliminary vessel‑tracking data compiled by Bloomberg, Kpler and Vortexa show Saudi’s daily crude output in August dropped by 1.12 million barrels to 6.98 million barrels, the lowest level since May, while daily exports fell by roughly one‑third from the previous month to just 3.03 million barrels.

The sharp supply contraction is linked to safety risks on Saudi Arabia’s two main export routes. Ongoing military clashes between the United States and Iran have not been resolved diplomatically, and shipping in the Persian Gulf has faced attacks and threats, severely disrupting crude flows through the Hormuz Strait. Although tanker traffic has not been completely halted, it is clearly below normal levels, leaving the energy market exposed to supply risk.

In the Red Sea, the Houthi movement continues to attack Saudi vessels and related shipping, further squeezing Saudi’s alternative export options via the Red Sea. On September 8 the Houthis claimed attacks on several southern Saudi cities and energy facilities; Saudi officials reported 73 injuries, fires at some facilities and temporary shutdowns, heightening market worries about Middle‑East supply disruptions.

Supply‑chain pressure remains a key driver of price gains. Brent crude recently rose to $97.92 a barrel, a six‑week high, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) topped $93. The market, however, has not yet broken the $100 barrier, constrained by some Gulf producers shifting to alternative routes, increased output from non‑OPEC countries, and a slowdown in global demand.

While Saudi output fell sharply, gains from Iraq and Venezuela offset part of OPEC’s overall decline. Bloomberg data show Iraq’s daily crude output rose by 270,000 barrels in August to 2.98 million barrels. Venezuela’s daily output increased by 70,000 barrels to 1.23 million barrels, a seven‑year peak.

Iraq’s actual exports also rose markedly. Reuters reported that Iraqi crude exports jumped from about 1.35 million barrels per day in July to roughly 2.34 million barrels per day in August, driven by export discounts, rebounding buyer demand and some tankers being allowed through the Hormuz Strait. State‑run SOMO even offered discounts of about $25‑$30 per barrel to attract China, India and other large buyers.

However, Venezuela’s production increase underscores emerging political fissures within OPEC. Bloomberg previously reported that Venezuela is seriously weighing an exit from OPEC, a topic now being discussed between Venezuelan and U.S. officials, though no final decision has been made yet.

U.S. President Donald Trump recently said that Venezuela’s OPEC membership should be decided by Caracas itself. At the same time, U.S. influence over Venezuela’s energy sector is expanding. Trump disclosed that the United States has secured agreements to enter 17 Venezuelan oil fields containing roughly 64 billion barrels of proven reserves, which could add up to 1.5 million barrels per day to U.S. supply if fully developed; major U.S. oil majors such as Exxon Mobil (XOM‑US) and Chevron (CVX‑US) were also named as potential investors.

If Venezuela ultimately leaves, it would be the second major OPEC member to exit within months after the United Arab Emirates’ departure in May, creating another blow to the cartel’s cohesion. Analysts believe Venezuela’s short‑term supply impact may be limited, but combined with Iraq’s dissatisfaction over quota allocations it could further weaken Saudi‑led OPEC’s ability to stay united and influence prices.

Facing supply constraints and internal rifts, OPEC+ core members have decided to pause any further production increases. After an online meeting on September 6 of the seven main participants – Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria and Oman – they agreed to keep October’s production policy unchanged, essentially using September’s set output as the October target. OPEC said the next meeting will be on October 4.

The decision means OPEC+ is temporarily hitting the brakes after six consecutive months of output hikes. The seven core members had agreed in August to raise output by about 188,000 barrels per day in September, gradually rolling back the 1.65 million‑barrel‑per‑day voluntary cuts introduced in 2023. In practice, actual output remains well below the paper quota because of Hormuz transport disruptions and supply issues in Russia and elsewhere, so higher quotas do not automatically translate into crude reaching the market.

Reuters noted that OPEC+’s influence on the physical oil market is now limited by war and logistics bottlenecks. Even if producers raise their quotas, there is no guarantee that the additional crude will be produced and shipped to consumers, shifting market focus from short‑term monthly increases to a reallocation of the 2027 production quota framework.

OPEC+ is also reviewing members’ maximum sustainable capacity to set a new 2027 production baseline. Texas‑based consultancy DeGolyer and MacNaughton is handling most capacity assessments, with a report expected by the end of September for OPEC, after which a new round of quota negotiations will begin. OPEC has previously confirmed that completing the maximum sustainable capacity assessment is a key input for the 2027 baseline.

This capacity review could become the most contentious issue for OPEC+ going forward. Iraq and other members have asked for higher quotas to reflect rising domestic capacity; the UAE once left OPEC after concluding that existing quotas did not reflect its growing output. If Venezuela also departs, internal disputes over quotas, fairness and market strategy could widen further.

Consequently, with paper‑based production policies being unwound while actual supply drops sharply due to war and transport bottlenecks, OPEC+ faces an unprecedented policy dilemma. Even though the alliance has rolled back part of the 2023 cuts, whether oil‑producing nations can turn nominal capacity into exportable crude now hinges on the security of the Hormuz Strait, the Red Sea and other energy transit routes.

Market attention has shifted from “Will OPEC+ increase output?” to “Can the added capacity actually reach the market?” As long as the Middle‑East conflict shows no clear de‑escalation, any new tanker attacks, damage to export facilities or further Hormuz disruptions could quickly widen the supply gap and push Brent back toward the $100‑a‑barrel threshold.

items.title: 貝森特警告日元空頭 「我現在是莊家」
items.title_en: Biden Warns Yen Short Sellers "I Am the House Now"
paras: 《彭博》報導，美國財務部長貝森特於週二(8日) 在德州南美洲達州大學(SMU) 公開向外匯交易員發出警告，切勿低估美日兩國維護日元穩定的決心。面對市場質疑美國財政部資金規模有限、難以持續支撐日元走勢的觀點，貝森特以「我現在就是莊家(I am the house now) 」強硬回應，強調自己掌握政策資訊不對稱的優勢，絕非在進行無把握的對賭。
美財長強調資訊優勢 嗆空頭「想對賭盡管來」
美方與日本政府於 7 月底發動歷史性的聯合買進日元干預行動，雖然日元短線急升，但隨後回升力道放緩，引發投機資金再度蠢蠢欲動。
對此，曾任對沖基金高管的貝森特反駁外界對護盤能力的質疑。他直言，身為財政部長使他擁有極高的資訊透明度，對日本政府及日本中央銀行(BOJ) 的政策方向均有深入了解與精準掌控。
他向試圖看空日元的交易員放話：「我現在就是莊家，如果有人想與我對賭，盡管來！」
日本財務大臣片山皋月 (Satsuki Katayama) 週二稍早證實，美日在匯率政策上保持高度一致。
美助日穩定匯率 背後戰略考量：避免日方拋售美債推高利率
外界關注美國為何反常介入日元匯率。
貝森特先前已說明，日本經濟已顯著走出長期通貨緊縮，「安倍經濟學(Abenomics) 」的超寬鬆階段已達終點，日本央行應逐步推動貨幣政策正常化。
更關鍵的戰略動機在於維護美國自身金融穩定。
若放任日元持續無序貶值，身為美國最大外國債權國的日本，恐被迫在公開市場大量拋售美債籌集美元以救匯。
這將導致美債價格暴跌、推升美國長天期國債收益率與借貸成本。因此，美方主動出手聯合護盤，正是為了防範美債市場遭到波及。
貨幣政策轉向在即 市場聚焦 9 月升息
除了美日兩國的口頭與資金干預，基本面也即將迎來變化。
市場傳出日本央行正考慮於 9 月 18 日的政策會議上將基準利率上調一碼(0.25 個百分點)。若日本央行順利重啟升息步伐，美日利差收窄將進一步打擊日元空頭，為日元匯率提供更實質的支撐。
美國財政部對匯率的關切加上美日政策協調，限制了日元過度貶值的空間。
美元兌日元(USD/JPY)週二一度突破 154 關卡，目前在 153.59 至 154.14 元兌1美元附近震盪，但對其他交叉盤的壓制依然明顯，歐元對日元 (EUR/JPY) 一度跌至 179.37，觸及九個月低點。
Bannockburn Global Forex 市場策略師 Marc Chandler 指出，當前行情更多是市場自發性的部位調整與套利平倉，而非官方直接干預。野村證券G10 外匯策略主管 Dominic Bunning 則表示，投資人正提前消化日本央行更為鷹派的立場。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: Bloomberg reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen warned foreign‑exchange traders on Tuesday (the 8th) at Southern Methodist University in Texas not to underestimate the resolve of the United States and Japan to keep the yen stable. When market participants questioned the Treasury’s limited funding and its ability to sustain yen support, Yellen responded forcefully, saying “I am the house now,” and stressed that her access to policy information gives her an asymmetrical advantage, not a reckless gamble.
Yellen stressed her informational edge and taunted short‑sellers, saying they can come and bet against her if they wish.

At the end of July the United States and Japan launched a historic joint yen‑buying intervention. The yen spiked sharply in the short term but then lost momentum, prompting speculative capital to stir again.

In response, Yellen – a former hedge‑fund executive – rebutted doubts about the ability to defend the currency. She said that as Treasury Secretary she enjoys a high degree of transparency and has deep, precise insight into the policy direction of the Japanese government and the Bank of Japan.
She told traders betting against the yen, "I am the house now; if anyone wants to bet against me, go ahead!"
Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama confirmed earlier on Tuesday that the United States and Japan remain closely aligned on exchange‑rate policy.
U.S. support for a stable yen reflects a broader strategic calculation: preventing Japan from dumping U.S. Treasuries and pushing up rates.
The market is wondering why the United States is unusually intervening in the yen market.
Yellen previously noted that Japan’s economy has moved out of a long‑standing deflationary period, that the ultra‑easy “Abenomics” phase is ending, and that the BOJ should gradually normalize policy.
A more critical strategic motive is to safeguard U.S. financial stability.

If the yen were allowed to keep depreciating disorderly, Japan – the largest foreign holder of U.S. debt – might be forced to sell large amounts of Treasuries in the open market to raise dollars for currency support.

That would cause Treasury prices to plunge and push up long‑term U.S. yields and borrowing costs. Hence the U.S. move to jointly defend the yen is aimed at preventing spill‑over into the Treasury market.
Monetary‑policy shift is imminent, with markets focusing on a September rate hike.
Beyond verbal and capital interventions by the U.S. and Japan, fundamentals are also about to change.

Rumors suggest the BOJ is considering raising its policy rate by one basis point (0.25 percentage points) at its September 18 meeting. If the BOJ successfully restarts rate hikes, the narrowing U.S.–Japan yield gap would further hurt yen short‑sellers and give the currency more concrete support.
U.S. Treasury concerns about exchange rates, combined with U.S.–Japan policy coordination, limit how far the yen can fall.

The USD/JPY pair briefly broke the 154 level on Tuesday and now oscillates around 153.59‑154.14 per dollar, while pressure on other crosses remains evident; EUR/JPY fell to 179.37, hitting a nine‑month low.

Bannockburn Global Forex strategist Marc Chandler said the current moves reflect market‑driven position adjustments and arbitrage unwinding rather than direct official intervention. Nomura’s G10 FX head Dominic Bunning added that investors are already pricing in a more hawkish stance from the BOJ.

items.title: 摩根士丹利：套利交易足以承受日元強升帶來的衝擊
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley: Arbitrage Trades Can Withstand the Impact of a Strong Yen
paras: 華爾街投行摩根士丹利(下稱大摩)最新表示，日元近期大幅升值，不太可能打亂新興市場廣受歡迎的套利交易。只要沒有其他因素推升整體市場波動，這類交易應足以承受日元升值帶來的衝擊。
以全球外匯和新興市場策略主管James Lord為首的大摩團隊在一份報告寫道：「對套利交易而言，更重要的是整體匯市波動的變化、全球經濟成長及股市前景，以及開發中世界經濟體本身是否具備吸引力的基本面題材。」
他們認為，全球經濟成長、全球股市表現，以及主要新興市場由個別基本面驅動的趨勢，對新興市場套利交易表現的影響，都比日元走勢更加重要。
目前已出現韌性的跡象。自7月29日以來，巴西雷亞爾和哥倫比亞披索對日元分別貶值5.1%和3.4%，但同期對美元分別升值0.7%和2.4%。
隨著交易員加大對日本央行(BOJ)升息的押注，同時警戒官方可能進一步採取行動支撐日元，日元兌美元匯率週二(8日)曾一度飆升至152.89，創今年2月中以來的最高水準。
日元近期反彈最初由BOJ升息預期推動，隨後技術因素進一步強化漲勢。市場對日本政府退休金投資基金可能調整資產配置的猜測，也增加了日元走強的動機。
BOJ下週將召開政策會議，目前市場已基本完全押注升息1碼。美國財長貝森特此前公開敦促BOJ提高利率，也強化市場對日美利差收窄的預期。
paras_en: Wall Street investment bank Morgan Stanley (referred to as "Morgan Stanley") recently said that the yen's recent sharp appreciation is unlikely to disrupt the popular arbitrage trades in emerging markets. As long as no other factors drive overall market volatility higher, these trades should be able to absorb the shock from the yen’s rise.

The Morgan Stanley team, led by global FX and emerging‑markets strategy head James Lord, wrote in a report: “For arbitrage trades, what matters more is the change in overall FX market volatility, global economic growth and equity market outlook, and whether the developing world economies themselves have attractive fundamental themes.”

They argue that global economic growth, global equity performance, and trends in major emerging markets driven by individual fundamentals have a bigger impact on emerging‑market arbitrage performance than the yen’s movement.

Resilience is already showing. Since July 29, the Brazilian real and Colombian peso have each weakened against the yen by 5.1% and 3.4%, while at the same time they have appreciated against the dollar by 0.7% and 2.4% respectively.

As traders increase bets on a rate hike by the Bank of Japan (BOJ) and remain wary that officials may take further steps to support the yen, the yen‑dollar pair spiked to 152.89 on Tuesday the 8th, its highest level since mid‑February this year.

The yen’s recent rebound was initially driven by expectations of a BOJ rate hike, with technical factors later amplifying the rise. Market speculation that Japan’s government pension investment fund may rebalance its asset allocation also added to the yen’s upward momentum.

The BOJ will hold a policy meeting next week, and the market is now essentially fully priced in a one‑basis‑point hike. U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen’s earlier public urging of the BOJ to raise rates has also reinforced market expectations of a narrowing Japan‑U.S. rate differential.

items.title: 三星4奈米逾半產能押注HBM4基礎裸片 月產1.5萬片全力衝刺
items.title_en: Samsung Allocates Over Half of 4nm Capacity to HBM4 Base Dies, Targeting 15,000 Wafers per Month
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，受全球AI算力驅動、HBM需求持續遠超供給影響，三星電子已將旗下4奈米製程超過50%產能分配給HBM相關記憶體晶片的核心基礎裸片生產，這部分產能目前已處於滿載運轉狀態，全力支撐HBM4產品的產能爬坡。
《Wccftech》與《ZDNet Korea》援引三星電子內外部消息人士報導，不同於採用客製化記憶體工藝製造的HBM DRAM堆疊模組，HBM底部的基礎裸片採用的是邏輯晶片製造工藝，承擔與上層DRAM堆疊互聯、集成記憶體控制器與物理層介面的核心功能，直接決定HBM整體資料傳輸效率與系統集成度。
截至上月，三星4奈米晶片產能中已有50%投入HBM4基礎裸片生產，目前該占比已進一步提升至50%至60%區間，對應月產能規模達1.5萬片晶圓。相關生產全部集中在三星平澤第二園區與第三園區的S5、S6兩條晶圓產線，兩座工廠的4奈米製程總產能為每月3萬片晶圓，剛好實現一半產能定向供給HBM4基礎裸片的配置。
三星憑藉自身同時涵蓋DRAM設計製造與先進邏輯代工的全鏈條能力，正大規模推進從4奈米到7奈米多工藝節點的HBM相關產品生產，憑藉獨有的記憶體與邏輯製造協同優勢，在HBM賽道形成差異化競爭力。
三星同時確定今年Q3進一步擴大HBM4產能的目標。此前行業數據顯示，今年Q2三星HBM全球市占率已攀升至38%，較一年前的15%實現翻倍增長，產能持續傾斜將進一步鞏固其在HBM市場的上升勢頭。
產業鏈長期技術布局同步推進。繼8月相關報導披露後，外媒進一步確認，三星正評估將2奈米製程應用於HBM基礎裸片的技術路線，擬改造位於器興工業區的一條現有產線，專門生產2奈米工藝的HBM基礎裸片，這部分下一代產品將定向供應給輝達，為其後續新一代AI加速晶片提供配套支持。
據悉，業界採用邏輯代工工藝生產HBM基礎裸片的趨勢，從HBM3與HBM3E時代就已開啟，更高的資料傳輸速率與引腳速度要求，倒逼基礎裸片必須使用更先進的邏輯工藝才能滿足性能指標。
目前，全球主要記憶體廠商選擇了完全不同的技術路線：三星堅持自主研發基礎裸片技術並依託自有晶圓廠生產，SK海力士選擇將相關生產外包給台積電，美光則採用專屬客製工藝推進研發。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that driven by global AI compute demand and HBM demand far outpacing supply, Samsung Electronics has allocated more than 50% of its 4nm process capacity to the core base die production for HBM‑related memory chips. This capacity is already running at full load to fully support the production ramp‑up of HBM4 products.

Wccftech and ZDNet Korea, citing Samsung insiders, note that unlike the customized memory process used for HBM DRAM stack modules, the base die at the bottom of the HBM stack is manufactured with a logic‑chip process. It handles the interconnect to the upper DRAM stack, the integrated memory controller and the physical‑layer interface, directly determining the overall data‑transfer efficiency and system integration of HBM.

As of last month, 50% of Samsung’s 4nm wafer capacity was already dedicated to HBM4 base die production, and that share has now risen to the 50‑60% range, corresponding to a monthly output of 15,000 wafers. All of this production is concentrated on Samsung’s Pyeongtaek‑2 and Pyeongtaek‑3 campuses on the S5 and S6 4nm lines, which together have a total capacity of 30,000 wafers per month, exactly half of which is earmarked for HBM4 base dies.

Leveraging its full‑chain capability that spans DRAM design and manufacturing as well as advanced logic foundry, Samsung is scaling production of HBM‑related products across multiple nodes from 4nm to 7nm. Its unique memory‑logic co‑manufacturing advantage gives it differentiated competitiveness in the HBM arena.

Samsung also confirmed a target to further expand HBM4 capacity in Q3 of this year. Industry data shows Samsung’s global HBM market share rose to 38% in Q2, up from 15% a year earlier, a doubling that, together with continued capacity bias, will further cement its upward momentum in the HBM market.

Long‑term technology road‑maps across the supply chain are progressing in parallel. After an August report, foreign media later confirmed that Samsung is evaluating a 2nm process for HBM base dies, planning to retrofit an existing line in the Gyeonggi‑industrial complex to produce 2nm‑node HBM base dies. The next‑generation product will be earmarked for Nvidia to support its upcoming AI accelerator chips.

Industry sources say the trend of using logic‑foundry processes to make HBM base dies began in the HBM3 and HBM3E era. Higher data‑rate and pin‑speed requirements force base dies to adopt more advanced logic nodes to meet performance targets.

Currently, the world’s major memory makers have taken completely different technical paths: Samsung insists on developing its own base‑die technology and producing it in‑house, SK Hynix outsources related production to TSMC, while Micron pursues a dedicated custom process for its development.

items.title: AI資料中心有錢也蓋不快！有電土地大缺貨 舊工廠變搶手資產
items.title_en: AI Data Centers Are Rich but Slow to Build! Power and Land Are in Short Supply, Old Factories Become Hot Assets
paras: 2026年09月09日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 全球AI資料中心的競賽，正從搶晶片轉向搶電力。決定誰能如期擴產的關鍵資源已經不是建設資金，而是已經接通電網、能在短期內交付使用的通電場址與工業用地。
應用數位Applied Digital(APLD-US)目前已簽約的資料中心關鍵IT負載達約1.4GW，對應基本租期合約收入約360億美元；原本做比特幣挖礦的Cipher Digital(CIFR-US，原名Cipher Mining)也轉身跳進超大型雲端業者的資料中心長約市場。雲端巨頭一口氣鎖下的電力容量，已經是以GW、以十年期以上合約在計算。
需求會如此集中湧向「已通電」場址，原因在於軟體與硬體的擴產速度完全脫節。

AI模型可以在數週內訓練完成、隔天上線，但電網要新增數十MW供電能力，不論砸多少錢都無法用同樣速度完成。應用數位旗下子公司與CoreWeave簽約，在Polaris Forge 1園區交付共400MW關鍵IT負載，首棟建物已於2025年11月完工商轉；2025年10月再與另一家美國投資等級雲端業者簽約，於Polaris Forge 2交付200MW。Cipher Digital則是把原本為比特幣挖礦打造的重電基礎建設，直接轉用於AI資料中心——與亞馬遜雲端服務(AWS)簽下15年、300MW的資料中心租約，還加碼與Fluidstack、Google簽下10年期AI代管協議，顯示需求已經從單一租約，擴散成多份長線合約疊加。

供給吃緊的根源，是電網併網與變電站建設的時程，原本就是以「年」為單位在跑，而不是以「季」為單位。顧問機構JLL估計，到2030年全球資料中心基礎建設投資規模可能上看3兆美元，同一期間新增產能約100GW，但這些數字能不能兌現，關鍵不在資金到不到位，而在併網排隊能不能跟上。這也是為什麼應用數位、Cipher Digital簽下的都是15年期的take-or-pay長約：雲端業者鎖的是未來十年以上的算力布局，而不是單一季度的急單。

供不應求的訊號也出現在傳統資料中心龍頭身上。數位房地產信託Digital Realty(DLR-US)第2季簽約的年化GAAP基本租金達3.07億美元，其中0至1MW以下加互連的最小型部署類別就貢獻1.08億美元，創下歷史新高；續約租金漲幅超過25%，在手訂單升至19億美元歷史新高，在建開發管線更達1.4GW，季底後又再簽下兩筆超大型客戶租約。連最小的機櫃部署都在創紀錄，意味著電力容量吃緊已是全尺度現象，不是只有頂級超大型客戶才搶得到電。
真正值得市場注意的，是電力本身正在從成本項目，變成決定訂單能不能拿到的關鍵資源。

當電網併網排不動，愈來愈多業者選擇繞過電網，直接採用表後發電作為備援或主力電源，這正是固態氧化物燃料電池廠布魯姆能源Bloom Energy(BE-US)的商機所在。連資料中心關鍵基礎設施龍頭Vertiv(VRT-US)都砸重金卡位，宣布以15億美元收購專精表後電力架構與微電網控制的Utility Innovation Group，讓Vertiv得以從專案啟動階段就切入電力配置，補上原本產品線搆不到的一段。
拉貨效應也已經開始轉化成業績數字：布魯姆能源第2季營收年增166%至10.65億美元，產品營收年增更達215%，全年財測上修至39億至42億美元；數位房地產信託同步上修全年核心FFO每股財測。
從簽約、擴產到財報數字，這波「搶電潮」正一路從故事變成看得見的業績成長。

paras_en: In the race for global AI data centers, the competition is shifting from securing chips to securing power. The key resource that determines who can expand on schedule is no longer construction capital, but sites that are already connected to the grid and can be delivered for use in the short term.

Applied Digital (APLD-US) has signed contracts for about 1.4 GW of critical IT load, corresponding to roughly $36 billion in base lease revenue. Cipher Digital (CIFR-US, formerly Cipher Mining) has also pivoted from Bitcoin mining to the long‑term market of ultra‑large cloud operators. The power capacity locked by cloud giants is already measured in gigawatts, with contracts spanning more than ten years.
The demand is so concentrated on “grid‑connected” sites because software and hardware expansion speeds are completely out of sync.

AI models can be trained in weeks and go live the next day, but adding tens of megawatts of grid capacity takes far longer, no matter how much money is spent. Applied Digital’s subsidiary and CoreWeave signed contracts to deliver 400 MW of critical IT load at Polaris Forge 1, with the first building completed in November 2025. In October 2025, they signed another US investment‑grade cloud operator to deliver 200 MW at Polaris Forge 2. Cipher Digital converted its Bitcoin‑mining power infrastructure directly to an AI data center, signing a 15‑year, 300 MW lease with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and adding 10‑year AI managed‑service agreements with Fluidstack and Google, showing demand has spread from single leases to multiple long‑term contracts.

The root of the supply crunch is the timetable for grid interconnection and substation construction, which runs on an annual basis rather than quarterly. Consulting firm JLL estimates that by 2030 global data‑center infrastructure investment could reach $3 trillion, with about 100 GW of new capacity added in the same period. Whether these numbers materialize depends not on capital availability but on whether interconnection queues can keep pace. That’s why Applied Digital and Cipher Digital signed 15‑year take‑or‑pay long‑term contracts: cloud operators lock in power for more than a decade, not for a single quarter.

Signs of supply‑side pressure also appear among traditional data‑center leaders. Digital Realty (DLR-US) signed a second‑quarter contract with an annual GAAP base rent of $307 million, with the smallest 0–1 MW interconnect deployments contributing $108 million, a record high. Renewal rent increases exceeded 25%, bringing in‑hand orders to a record $1.9 billion, with a development pipeline of 1.4 GW. At the end of the quarter, two more large‑scale customer leases were signed. Even the smallest cabinet deployments are breaking records, indicating that power scarcity is a full‑scale phenomenon, not just a premium for top‑tier customers.
What truly matters to the market is that power itself is shifting from a cost item to a critical resource that determines whether an order can be won.

When grid interconnection stalls, more operators are opting to bypass the grid and use behind‑the‑meter generation as backup or primary power. This is the opportunity for solid‑oxide fuel‑cell manufacturer Bloom Energy (BE-US). Even Vertiv (VRT-US), a leader in critical data‑center infrastructure, is investing heavily, announcing a $1.5 billion acquisition of Utility Innovation Group, which specializes in behind‑the‑meter power architecture and microgrid control, allowing Vertiv to enter power configuration from the project initiation stage.

The pull‑in effect is already translating into performance numbers: Bloom Energy’s second‑quarter revenue grew 166% year‑over‑year to $1.065 billion, product revenue grew 215%, and full‑year guidance was raised to $3.9 billion to $4.2 billion. Digital Realty also raised its full‑year core FFO per‑share guidance.
From signing contracts to expanding capacity to reporting financials, this wave of “power‑seeking” is turning stories into tangible growth.

paras_en: September 9, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – The global AI data‑center race is shifting from grabbing chips to grabbing electricity. The scarcest resource is no longer construction capital but industrial land that is already connected to the grid and can be delivered in the short term. Because large‑scale grid interconnection and substation construction often take years, existing high‑power plants, Bitcoin mining sites and on‑site generation assets are becoming the new assets AI compute providers are fighting over.

The supply‑demand gap is evident from construction scale. JLL estimates that from 2026 to 2030 the world will add about 100 GW of data‑center capacity, with related infrastructure investment potentially reaching $3 trillion. Yet software models can be updated in weeks, while adding tens of megawatts of power cannot keep pace, leaving many data centers stuck in grid‑connection queues, substation and transmission upgrades even after they secure land and funding.

What the market should really note is that this power‑grab wave is spreading from ultra‑large parks of several hundred MW or even GW to medium‑size projects of 20 MW to 100 MW. Although smaller, these projects can fill the gap created by the long construction periods of large parks and developers who cannot obtain sufficient power.

Healthy Choice Wellness (HCWC‑US) plans to acquire Host Digital Infrastructure via a reverse merger. Host has signed a 15‑year, $1.25 billion lease for a 43 MW critical IT load on an existing industrial building in northeast Oklahoma; if all renewal options are exercised, the 30‑year contract could total $3.2 billion.

The building is roughly 80,000 sq ft with existing power load exceeding 45 MW, unlike new sites still waiting for grid interconnection. The company expects delivery in the first half of 2027 to a tenant described as a large global private‑cloud infrastructure provider, with support expected from a U.S. investment‑grade tech company, though neither name is disclosed.

The scale of contracts signed by large players shows the power‑capacity battle now extends for decades. Applied Digital (APLD‑US) has already signed contracts for about 1.4 GW of critical IT load, generating roughly $36 billion of base‑lease revenue, including 400 MW supplied to CoreWeave and 200 MW to another U.S. investment‑grade ultra‑large cloud provider.

Formerly Cipher Mining, now renamed Cipher Digital (CIFR‑US) this year, is also repurposing its heavy‑power assets built for Bitcoin mining toward AI data centers. The company has a 300 MW, 15‑year data‑center lease with Amazon Web Services and has acquired a majority stake in a 1 GW project in West Texas, slated to be powered up by 2028.

Power shortages are not limited to large parks. Digital Realty (DLR‑US) signed leases in Q2 that are expected to generate $307 million of annualized base rent, with the 0‑1 MW and interconnect business contributing $108 million – a record high. Backlog rose to $1.9 billion and renewal rent spreads exceeded 25%. Demand appears across small deployments to ultra‑large parks, indicating tight supply across all capacity tiers.

The power‑grab effect is also spreading to on‑site generation. Bloom Energy (BE‑US), a solid‑oxide fuel‑cell maker, reported Q2 revenue up 166% year‑over‑year to $1.065 billion, product revenue up 215%, and raised its full‑year 2026 revenue outlook to $3.9‑$4.2 billion. Companies are willing to bear higher generation costs for on‑site power, reflecting that the time cost of waiting for grid completion can be more burdensome than electricity price differentials.

items.title: 財經名嘴點名輝達與博通 看好成為OpenAI GPT-6 Astra受惠股
items.title_en: Financial Commentator Names Nvidia and Broadcom as Likely Beneficiaries of OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra
paras: CNBC財經節目主持人Jim Cramer周二(8日)表示，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)與博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)是最有可能受惠於OpenAI推出GPT-6 Astra模型的兩檔股票。
Cramer認為，輝達應該因為讓Astra得以問世而獲得肯定。根據輝達執行長黃仁勳，訓練Astra使用了10萬顆輝達Blackwell GPU。
Astra自上周開始分階段推出後，因OpenAI宣稱該模型在網路安全與電腦操作任務方面取得突破，而受到市場關注。
黃仁勳在X平台上的貼文指出，目前還有另外40萬顆GPU正在陸續投入OpenAI的運算環境。這個數字顯示，市場對輝達硬體的需求正在快速擴大。
輝達股價周二開盤走高，但之後轉跌約2%。
Cramer表示，「我認為你應該買進的股票是輝達。」他指出，輝達「完全沒有做錯任何事情」，反而是在做正確的事情，因為輝達正是OpenAI能夠取得如此優異表現的原因之一。
博通受惠的方式則有所不同。該公司與OpenAI合作開發了一款名為Jalapeno的客製化晶片，主要用於AI推論，也就是AI模型日常運作、執行任務的階段，而不是訓練模型。
由於Astra獲得市場高度關注，進一步強化OpenAI在AI競賽中的地位，Cramer認為，這也將提升市場對博通客製化晶片業務的信心。
博通股價周二上漲2.9%。
Cramer表示，如果OpenAI與Anthropic能夠完成原先規劃的IPO，「如果他們成功做到這件事，博通就是他們最優先的合作夥伴，而我們將會看到股價大幅上漲。」
博通目前的客製化晶片客戶包括OpenAI與Anthropic。根據博通執行長陳福陽(Hock Tan)，Anthropic預計將在2027會計年度成為公司最大的客製化晶片客戶，並持續維持這個地位至2028會計年度。而OpenAI預計將在同一年成為博通的第二大客戶。
Cramer表示，投資人對輝達與博通兩家晶片公司的信心，都與OpenAI在AI競賽中的競爭地位密切相關。OpenAI目前的競爭對手包括Anthropic以及各種開源AI模型。
由於OpenAI已承諾投入巨額資金建設運算基礎設施，投資人正密切關注OpenAI能否持續站在AI研究的最前線。市場認為OpenAI能否維持這種領先地位，將是決定公司能否持續發展的重要因素，也關係到市場對其可能在2027年IPO 的期待。
Cramer認為，整個AI晶片產業的需求足夠龐大，因此多家公司可以同時受惠，不會出現「只有一家企業吃下所有AI晶片訂單」的情況。
paras_en: CNBC financial show host Jim Cramer said on Tuesday (8th) that Nvidia (NVDA-US) and Broadcom (AVGO-US) are the two stocks most likely to benefit from OpenAI’s launch of the GPT-6 Astra model.
Cramer believes Nvidia should be credited for enabling Astra’s debut. According to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, training Astra used 100,000 Nvidia Blackwell GPUs.
Since last week, Astra has been rolled out in phases and has attracted market attention after OpenAI claimed breakthroughs in cybersecurity and computer operations tasks.
Huang’s post on X noted that another 400,000 GPUs are gradually being added to OpenAI’s compute environment, indicating rapid growth in demand for Nvidia hardware.
Nvidia’s stock opened higher on Tuesday but then fell about 2%.

Cramer said, “I think the stock you should buy is Nvidia.” He added that Nvidia has “done nothing wrong” and is instead doing the right thing, as it is one of the reasons OpenAI can achieve such outstanding performance.

Broadcom’s benefit comes in a different way. The company has partnered with OpenAI to develop a custom chip called Jalapeno, primarily used for AI inference—the phase where AI models run and perform tasks, not training.
Because Astra has attracted high market attention and further strengthens OpenAI’s position in the AI race, Cramer believes this will boost confidence in Broadcom’s custom chip business.
Broadcom’s stock rose 2.9% on Tuesday.
Cramer said that if OpenAI and Anthropic can complete their planned IPO, “if they succeed, Broadcom will be their top partner and we will see a sharp rise in the stock.”

Broadcom’s current custom chip customers include OpenAI and Anthropic. According to Broadcom CEO Hock Tan, Anthropic is expected to become the company’s largest custom chip customer in FY2027 and maintain that status through FY2028, while OpenAI is expected to become the second largest customer in the same year.

Cramer noted that investors’ confidence in Nvidia and Broadcom is closely tied to OpenAI’s competitive position in the AI race. OpenAI’s current competitors include Anthropic and various open‑source AI models.

Because OpenAI has pledged massive investment in building compute infrastructure, investors are closely watching whether OpenAI can continue to stay at the forefront of AI research. The market believes whether OpenAI can maintain this lead will be a key factor in the company’s continued development and its potential IPO in 2027.

Cramer believes the demand for the entire AI chip industry is large enough that multiple companies can benefit simultaneously, and there will not be a situation where only one company captures all AI chip orders.

items.title: 貝森特警告日元空頭 「我現在是莊家」
items.title_en: Biden Warns Yen Short Sellers "I Am the House Now"
paras: 《彭博》報導，美國財務部長貝森特於週二(8日) 在德州南美洲達州大學(SMU) 公開向外匯交易員發出警告，切勿低估美日兩國維護日元穩定的決心。面對市場質疑美國財政部資金規模有限、難以持續支撐日元走勢的觀點，貝森特以「我現在就是莊家(I am the house now) 」強硬回應，強調自己掌握政策資訊不對稱的優勢，絕非在進行無把握的對賭。
美財長強調資訊優勢 嗆空頭「想對賭盡管來」
美方與日本政府於 7 月底發動歷史性的聯合買進日元干預行動，雖然日元短線急升，但隨後回升力道放緩，引發投機資金再度蠢蠢欲動。
對此，曾任對沖基金高管的貝森特反駁外界對護盤能力的質疑。他直言，身為財政部長使他擁有極高的資訊透明度，對日本政府及日本中央銀行(BOJ) 的政策方向均有深入了解與精準掌控。
他向試圖看空日元的交易員放話：「我現在就是莊家，如果有人想與我對賭，盡管來！」
日本財務大臣片山皋月 (Satsuki Katayama) 週二稍早證實，美日在匯率政策上保持高度一致。
美助日穩定匯率 背後戰略考量：避免日方拋售美債推高利率
外界關注美國為何反常介入日元匯率。
貝森特先前已說明，日本經濟已顯著走出長期通貨緊縮，「安倍經濟學(Abenomics) 」的超寬鬆階段已達終點，日本央行應逐步推動貨幣政策正常化。
更關鍵的戰略動機在於維護美國自身金融穩定。
若放任日元持續無序貶值，身為美國最大外國債權國的日本，恐被迫在公開市場大量拋售美債籌集美元以救匯。
這將導致美債價格暴跌、推升美國長天期國債收益率與借貸成本。因此，美方主動出手聯合護盤，正是為了防範美債市場遭到波及。
貨幣政策轉向在即 市場聚焦 9 月升息
除了美日兩國的口頭與資金干預，基本面也即將迎來變化。
市場傳出日本央行正考慮於 9 月 18 日的政策會議上將基準利率上調一碼(0.25 個百分點)。若日本央行順利重啟升息步伐，美日利差收窄將進一步打擊日元空頭，為日元匯率提供更實質的支撐。
美國財政部對匯率的關切加上美日政策協調，限制了日元過度貶值的空間。
美元兌日元(USD/JPY)週二一度突破 154 關卡，目前在 153.59 至 154.14 元兌1美元附近震盪，但對其他交叉盤的壓制依然明顯，歐元對日元 (EUR/JPY) 一度跌至 179.37，觸及九個月低點。
Bannockburn Global Forex 市場策略師 Marc Chandler 指出，當前行情更多是市場自發性的部位調整與套利平倉，而非官方直接干預。野村證券G10 外匯策略主管 Dominic Bunning 則表示，投資人正提前消化日本央行更為鷹派的立場。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: Bloomberg reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen warned foreign‑exchange traders on Tuesday (the 8th) at Southern Methodist University in Texas not to underestimate the resolve of the United States and Japan to keep the yen stable. When market participants questioned the Treasury’s limited funding and its ability to sustain yen support, Yellen responded forcefully, saying “I am the house now,” and stressed that her access to policy information gives her an asymmetrical advantage, not a reckless gamble.
Yellen stressed her informational edge and taunted short‑sellers, saying they can come and bet against her if they wish.

At the end of July the United States and Japan launched a historic joint yen‑buying intervention. The yen spiked sharply in the short term but then lost momentum, prompting speculative capital to stir again.

In response, Yellen – a former hedge‑fund executive – rebutted doubts about the ability to defend the currency. She said that as Treasury Secretary she enjoys a high degree of transparency and has deep, precise insight into the policy direction of the Japanese government and the Bank of Japan.
She told traders betting against the yen, "I am the house now; if anyone wants to bet against me, go ahead!"
Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama confirmed earlier on Tuesday that the United States and Japan remain closely aligned on exchange‑rate policy.
U.S. support for a stable yen reflects a broader strategic calculation: preventing Japan from dumping U.S. Treasuries and pushing up rates.
The market is wondering why the United States is unusually intervening in the yen market.
Yellen previously noted that Japan’s economy has moved out of a long‑standing deflationary period, that the ultra‑easy “Abenomics” phase is ending, and that the BOJ should gradually normalize policy.
A more critical strategic motive is to safeguard U.S. financial stability.

If the yen were allowed to keep depreciating disorderly, Japan – the largest foreign holder of U.S. debt – might be forced to sell large amounts of Treasuries in the open market to raise dollars for currency support.

That would cause Treasury prices to plunge and push up long‑term U.S. yields and borrowing costs. Hence the U.S. move to jointly defend the yen is aimed at preventing spill‑over into the Treasury market.
Monetary‑policy shift is imminent, with markets focusing on a September rate hike.
Beyond verbal and capital interventions by the U.S. and Japan, fundamentals are also about to change.

Rumors suggest the BOJ is considering raising its policy rate by one basis point (0.25 percentage points) at its September 18 meeting. If the BOJ successfully restarts rate hikes, the narrowing U.S.–Japan yield gap would further hurt yen short‑sellers and give the currency more concrete support.
U.S. Treasury concerns about exchange rates, combined with U.S.–Japan policy coordination, limit how far the yen can fall.

The USD/JPY pair briefly broke the 154 level on Tuesday and now oscillates around 153.59‑154.14 per dollar, while pressure on other crosses remains evident; EUR/JPY fell to 179.37, hitting a nine‑month low.

Bannockburn Global Forex strategist Marc Chandler said the current moves reflect market‑driven position adjustments and arbitrage unwinding rather than direct official intervention. Nomura’s G10 FX head Dominic Bunning added that investors are already pricing in a more hawkish stance from the BOJ.
(This article is not available for partner re‑publication)

items.title: 摩根士丹利：套利交易足以承受日元強升帶來的衝擊
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley: Arbitrage Trades Can Withstand the Impact of a Strong Yen
paras: 華爾街投行摩根士丹利(下稱大摩)最新表示，日元近期大幅升值，不太可能打亂新興市場廣受歡迎的套利交易。只要沒有其他因素推升整體市場波動，這類交易應足以承受日元升值帶來的衝擊。
以全球外匯和新興市場策略主管James Lord為首的大摩團隊在一份報告寫道：「對套利交易而言，更重要的是整體匯市波動的變化、全球經濟成長及股市前景，以及開發中世界經濟體本身是否具備吸引力的基本面題材。」
他們認為，全球經濟成長、全球股市表現，以及主要新興市場由個別基本面驅動的趨勢，對新興市場套利交易表現的影響，都比日元走勢更加重要。
目前已出現韌性的跡象。自7月29日以來，巴西雷亞爾和哥倫比亞披索對日元分別貶值5.1%和3.4%，但同期對美元分別升值0.7%和2.4%。
隨著交易員加大對日本央行(BOJ)升息的押注，同時警戒官方可能進一步採取行動支撐日元，日元兌美元匯率週二(8日)曾一度飆升至152.89，創今年2月中以來的最高水準。
日元近期反彈最初由BOJ升息預期推動，隨後技術因素進一步強化漲勢。市場對日本政府退休金投資基金可能調整資產配置的猜測，也增加了日元走強的動機。
BOJ下週將召開政策會議，目前市場已基本完全押注升息1碼。美國財長貝森特此前公開敦促BOJ提高利率，也強化市場對日美利差收窄的預期。
paras_en: Wall Street investment bank Morgan Stanley (referred to as "Morgan Stanley") recently said that the yen's recent sharp appreciation is unlikely to disrupt the popular arbitrage trades in emerging markets. As long as no other factors drive overall market volatility higher, these trades should be able to absorb the shock from the yen’s rise.

The Morgan Stanley team, led by global FX and emerging‑markets strategy head James Lord, wrote in a report: “For arbitrage trades, what matters more is the change in overall FX market volatility, global economic growth and equity market outlook, and whether the developing world economies themselves have attractive fundamental themes.”

They argue that global economic growth, global equity performance, and trends in major emerging markets driven by individual fundamentals have a bigger impact on emerging‑market arbitrage performance than the yen’s movement.

Resilience is already showing. Since July 29, the Brazilian real and Colombian peso have each weakened against the yen by 5.1% and 3.4%, while at the same time they have appreciated against the dollar by 0.7% and 2.4% respectively.

As traders increase bets on a rate hike by the Bank of Japan (BOJ) and remain wary that officials may take further steps to support the yen, the yen‑dollar pair spiked to 152.89 on Tuesday the 8th, its highest level since mid‑February this year.

The yen’s recent rebound was initially driven by expectations of a BOJ rate hike, with technical factors later amplifying the rise. Market speculation that Japan’s government pension investment fund may rebalance its asset allocation also added to the yen’s upward momentum.

The BOJ will hold a policy meeting next week, and the market is now essentially fully priced in a one‑basis‑point hike. U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen’s earlier public urging of the BOJ to raise rates has also reinforced market expectations of a narrowing Japan‑U.S. rate differential.

items.title: 川普曬「新版美國地圖」劃入20主權國家　多國怒表不滿、冰島急召美大使抗議
items.title_en: Trump Posts “New US Map” Including 20 Sovereign Nations, Prompting Anger from Multiple Countries and Iceland Summoning US Ambassador in Protest
paras: 美國總統川普週二(8日)在社群媒體上發布一張「美國地圖」，震驚國際社會並引發多國抗議，圖中美國版圖竟涵蓋現實中的20個主權國家，以及丹麥、英國、法國與荷蘭的海外屬地。
根據美國《新聞周刊》分析，這版地圖不僅包括川普多次揚言納入美國版圖的加拿大，還納入冰島、墨西哥、古巴、尼加拉瓜、宏都拉斯、牙買加等一眾主權國家，且涵蓋英屬維京群島、法屬聖馬丁、荷屬聖馬丁等西歐國家領地，以及川普屢次表示應歸屬美國的格陵蘭。若剔除西歐屬地、僅計算主權國家，數量仍多達20個。
目前，多個被這張地圖「吞併」的國家已公開表達不滿。墨西哥總統辛鮑姆在貼文中明確表示，墨西哥「現在不是、將來也不會是任何外國的殖民地或保護國」。
《路透社》報導，冰島外長貢納爾斯多蒂爾直接召見美國駐冰島大使提出抗議，丹麥首相弗雷澤里克森則再次強調，格陵蘭人民「不想成為美國人」。
此事在社群媒體上亦引爆全球網民爭議。不少外國網民指出，美國政府經常攻擊、抹黑中國有領土野心，但這張地圖卻充分暴露了美國自身的野心。
更有人批評，西方媒體對此事關注度遠不及他們跟中國找碴時的猛烈程度，有人直言若中國也如此塗抹東亞或東南亞地圖，西方媒體早就炸鍋了。
對於這場風波，《新聞周刊》引述一名美國政治學學者提醒，雖然這張地圖不意味著美國會一夜之間吞併這些國家，但若相關國家選擇沉默，這種沉默就可能被解讀為默許。因此，該學者認為各國應認真以對，作出明確回應。
paras_en: US President Donald Trump posted a “US map” on social media on Tuesday (the 8th), shocking the international community and sparking protests from many nations. The map shows the United States’ territory encompassing 20 real‑world sovereign countries, as well as overseas territories of Denmark, the United Kingdom, France and the Netherlands.

According to an analysis by Newsweek, the map not only includes Canada, which Trump has repeatedly claimed should be incorporated into the US, but also adds sovereign states such as Iceland, Mexico, Cuba, Nicaragua, Honduras and Jamaica, and it covers the British Virgin Islands, the French side of Saint Martin, the Dutch side of Saint Martin and other Western European territories, as well as Greenland, which Trump has long said should belong to the United States. Even if the Western European territories are excluded and only sovereign nations are counted, the total still reaches 20.

So far, several of the countries “absorbed” by the map have publicly expressed their displeasure. Mexican President Andrés Manuel López Obrador wrote in a post that Mexico “is not now, nor will ever be, a colony or protectorate of any foreign power.”

Reuters reported that Iceland’s foreign minister, Þórdís Gylfadóttir, summoned the US ambassador to Iceland to lodge a protest, and Denmark’s prime minister, Mette Frederiksen, reiterated that the people of Greenland “do not want to become Americans.”

The issue has also ignited a global debate on social media. Many foreign netizens pointed out that the US government frequently attacks and smears China for alleged territorial ambitions, yet this map lays bare America’s own expansionist aspirations.

Others criticized that Western media’s coverage of the incident is far less intense than the fervor they display when confronting China. Some even said that if China were to redraw East Asian or Southeast Asian maps in the same way, Western media would be in an uproar.

Regarding the controversy, Newsweek quoted a US political‑science scholar who warned that, while the map does not mean the United States will annex these countries overnight, silence from the affected nations could be interpreted as tacit approval. The scholar therefore urged all countries to respond seriously and issue clear statements.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走弱 市場聚焦關鍵通膨數據
items.title_en: <New York Forex Market> Dollar Weakens as Market Focuses on Key Inflation Data
paras: 美元周二(8日)走弱，在前一交易日因市場提高對聯準會(Fed)升息的押注而上漲後，暫時喘口氣。同時，日元的強勁漲勢持續，成為外匯市場關注焦點之一。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.3%，報98.86。
美元下一步的走勢，很可能取決於本周即將公布的關鍵通膨數據。上周五公布的強勁8月就業報告，迅速改變了市場對聯準會貨幣政策前景的看法。
美國勞工統計局(BLS)公布，8月非農就業人口增加16.2萬人，接近市場原先預期5.5萬人的三倍。失業率則維持在4.1%。
此外，6月與7月的非農就業人數也向上修正，兩個月合計增加5.5萬人。
這些數據顯示，美國勞動市場依然具有相當韌性。再加上通膨仍偏高，意味著美國經濟可能面臨過熱與持續價格壓力。
在這種情況下，中央銀行通常會考慮採取緊縮貨幣政策。
市場也因此提高了對聯準會本月稍晚升息0.25個百分點的預期。根據CME FedWatch工具，目前市場認為聯準會本月升息1碼的機率約為60%。
這份就業數據公布前，聯準會官員的言論其實也相當分歧。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在8月底傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)演講中展現出相當鷹派的立場。
但另一方面，聯準會公開市場委員會(FOMC)的投票委員、紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)及理事華勒(Christopher Waller)，上周則發表了較為鴿派的言論。
因此，現在市場將高度關注本周即將公布的8月生產者物價指數(PPI)與消費者物價指數(CPI)，以進一步判斷聯準會在9月16日的政策決定。
摩根大通由Michael Feroli率領的分析團隊周五表示，「近期聯準會官員的談話顯示，他們對勞動市場有信心，這意味著接下來公布的通膨數據，將成為判斷聯準會是否升息及何時升息的關鍵。因此，8月就業報告必須非常疲弱，才可能改變目前的政策判斷。但事實上，這份報告表現相當不錯，因此對聯準會政策觀察人士而言，接下來的焦點自然轉向本周的通膨數據。」
摩根大通分析師預期，接下來公布的核心 CPI月增率為0.21%。他們認為，如果數據真的落在這個水準，可能低到足以讓聯準會至少在9月會議之前維持利率不變。
日元漲勢暫歇
日元略微走弱至1美元兌154.22日元，此前一度升至152.89，創下1月30日以來日元兌美元的最強水準。
日元這波升勢主要受到市場對日本未來貨幣政策路徑大幅重新評估的推動，而強勁的經濟數據，以及日本政府明確支持日元的態度，也進一步強化了這股漲勢。
日本周二公布的國內生產毛額(GDP)修正數據顯示，4-6月季度經濟年化成長率為1.4%，高於初步估計的1.1%。
這項數據進一步支持日本銀行(BoJ)可能在本月稍晚升息的看法。目前市場認為日本央行本月升息的機率已經提高到75%。
日元剛度過7月下旬以來表現最好的一周。當時美國與日本當局曾進行一次歷史性的聯合干預行動，推升日元。雖然上周市場同樣盛傳日本可能再次進場干預匯市，但外匯市場參與者認為，市場對日本升息預期的升溫才是近期推動日元上漲的主要原因。
日本央行官員近期也發表偏向鷹派的言論，包括日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)以及理事高田創(Hajime Takata)。
日本財務大臣片山皋月(Satsuki Katayama)周二再次表示，日本目前的匯率政策立場仍與美國保持一致，並確認自己持續與美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)保持密切溝通。
包括此次美日聯合干預在內，日本從7月 30日至8月26日期間，總計動用創紀錄的 15兆日圓(約 971.8億美元)來支撐日元。
在其他貨幣方面，加拿大幣走強。美元兌加幣下跌0.3%，至1.3779。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Tuesday (the 8th), taking a breather after having risen the previous session when markets raised bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.3% to 98.86.
The dollar’s next move will likely hinge on key inflation data due later this week. A strong August jobs report released last Friday quickly shifted market views on the Fed’s policy outlook.

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that non‑farm payrolls rose by 162,000 in August, roughly three times the market’s original expectation of 55,000. The unemployment rate held steady at 4.1%.
In addition, June and July payroll figures were revised upward, adding a combined 55,000 jobs over the two months.
These numbers show that the U.S. labor market remains fairly resilient. Coupled with still‑elevated inflation, they suggest the U.S. economy may be overheating and facing continued price pressure.
In such a setting, central banks typically consider tightening monetary policy.

Markets have therefore lifted expectations that the Fed will raise rates by a quarter‑percentage point later this month. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability of a 25‑basis‑point hike this month is about 60%.
Before the jobs data were released, Fed officials’ comments were already quite divided. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh took a decidedly hawkish tone in his Jackson Hole speech at the end of August.
Conversely, FOMC voting members New York Fed President John Williams and Governor Christopher Waller delivered more dovish remarks last week.
Consequently, markets are now watching closely the August Producer Price Index (PPI) and Consumer Price Index (CPI) due this week to gauge the Fed’s likely decision at its September 16 meeting.

JPMorgan analysts led by Michael Feroli said on Friday that “recent Fed officials’ remarks show confidence in the labor market, meaning the upcoming inflation numbers will be the key to judging whether and when the Fed will hike. Thus, the August jobs report would have to be very weak to change the current policy view. In fact, the report was quite strong, so the focus naturally shifts to this week’s inflation data.”

JPMorgan expects the core CPI month‑over‑month increase to be 0.21%. They believe that if the data land at that level, it could be low enough for the Fed to keep rates unchanged at least until the September meeting.
Yen rally pauses
The yen slipped slightly to ¥154.22 per dollar after briefly climbing to ¥152.89, its strongest level against the dollar since Jan. 30.
The yen’s recent rise has been driven by a major reassessment of Japan’s future monetary‑policy path, bolstered by strong economic data and the government’s clear support for the currency.
Japan’s revised GDP figures released on Tuesday showed the economy grew at an annualised 1.4% in the April‑June quarter, above the preliminary estimate of 1.1%.
That data further backs the view that the Bank of Japan could raise rates later this month. The market now sees a 75% chance of a BOJ hike this month.

The yen just completed its best week since late July, when U.S. and Japanese authorities carried out a historic joint intervention that lifted the currency. Although rumors of another Japanese intervention circulated last week, FX participants say the warming expectations of a BOJ rate hike are the main driver of the recent yen gains.
BOJ officials have also recently made more hawkish comments, including Governor Kazuo Ueda and board member Hajime Takata.

Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Tuesday that Japan’s current exchange‑rate stance remains aligned with the United States and confirmed she continues close communication with U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.
Including the recent joint U.S.–Japan intervention, Japan deployed a record ¥15 trillion (about $97.18 billion) to support the yen between July 30 and Aug. 26.
In other currencies, the Canadian dollar strengthened. The USD/CAD pair fell 0.3% to 1.3779.
Canada’s retaliatory tariff on U.S. imports worth $27.6 billion took effect on Tuesday.

items.title: USD/JPY：日圓升至七個月高點、逼近153日圓，市場幾乎已消化日本央行升息預期
items.title_en: USD/JPY: Yen Rises to Seven-Month High, Nearing ¥153, Market Almost Fully Prices in BOJ Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 要點：

日圓持續大幅升值
一週內從160日圓升至153日圓
市場已消化日本央行升息預期


美元兌日圓在短短一週內，已從160日圓上方一路跌向153日圓附近。偏偏就在你剛平掉空單的時候，對吧？
日圓突破干預價位

週二，USD/JPY跌向153日圓，使日圓升至2月以來最強水準。就在上週，美元兌日圓還一度突破160日圓，意味著短短幾天內，日圓已升值約4%。



此波走勢使美元兌日圓跌破日本與美國在7月聯手干預後所觸及的價位。



日本當局在7月30日至8月26日期間動用創紀錄的15.4兆日圓（965億美元）支撐日圓。這一次，推動日圓走強的主要力量則來自貨幣政策預期。



交易員正在回補先前累積的日圓空頭部位。當時日本利率明顯低於其他已開發市場，因此交易員大量放空日圓。這些部位通常用於套利交易：以低利率借入日圓，再購買其他市場中殖利率較高的資產。


日本央行升息更近一步

日本將第二季經濟成長率上修至年化1.4%，主要受到企業投資強於預期的支撐。



7月實質薪資年增2.4%，創2021年5月以來最大增幅，並連續第七個月成長。購買力提升，讓日本經濟有更大的空間承受較高的借貸成本。



目前掉期市場顯示，日本央行於9月18日將政策利率上調25個基點至1.25%的機率約為98%。市場也已完全反映1月前進一步升息至1.5%的預期。



財務大臣片山皐月表示，在罕見的聯合干預行動後，東京與華盛頓仍保持一致，致力於推動匯率市場維持穩定。


CPI可能打斷日圓漲勢

美元方面的情況仍然複雜。8月非農就業人數增加162,000人，接近市場預期的三倍，使聯準會下週升息的機率升至約60%。



通常而言，美國利率上升會擴大美元資產的殖利率優勢，進而支撐美元兌日圓。



然而，美元指數週二跌至約98.80的兩週低點。財政疑慮以及美國通膨數據公布前的謹慎情緒正在限制美元的反應。


現在該關注什麼

美國生產者物價指數（PPI）將於週四公布，接著週五公布消費者物價指數（CPI）。若數據偏高，可能推高美國國債殖利率，甚至在日本央行出手前就引發美元強勁反彈。
從圖表來看，153日圓是眼前的重要樞紐位，接下來則是152日圓，以及具有心理意義的150日圓關卡。阻力位則位於前次干預後形成的約155日圓附近。
若價格持續跌破該區域，將確認趨勢已經轉變；但若美國CPI數據偏高，也可能提醒日圓多頭，目前正有兩家央行爭相扮演「鷹派」角色。

paras_en: Key points:
The yen continues to appreciate sharply, climbing from around ¥160 to ¥153 within a week, and the market has already priced in expectations of a Bank of Japan rate hike.

The yen broke through the intervention level. On Tuesday, USD/JPY fell toward ¥153, pushing the yen to its strongest level since February. Just last week the pair had briefly surged past ¥160, meaning the yen has appreciated about 4% in just a few days.

This move took USD/JPY below the level reached after the joint Japan‑U.S. intervention in July. Japanese authorities intervened from July 30 to August 26, deploying a record ¥15.4 trillion (about $96.5 billion) to support the yen. This time, the main driver of the yen’s strength is monetary‑policy expectations. Traders are covering previously built short‑yen positions that were taken when Japan’s rates were clearly lower than those in other developed markets, allowing large‑scale yen‑shorting for carry trades (borrowing yen at low rates to buy higher‑yielding assets elsewhere).

The Bank of Japan moves closer to raising rates. Japan has revised its Q2 growth forecast up to an annualised 1.4%, supported mainly by stronger‑than‑expected corporate investment. In July, real wages rose 2.4% year‑on‑year—the biggest increase since May 2021—and marked the seventh consecutive month of growth, boosting purchasing power and giving the economy more room to absorb higher borrowing costs. The swap market now shows a roughly 98% probability that the BOJ will raise its policy rate by 25 basis points to 1.25% on September 18, and the market has already fully priced in expectations of a further hike to 1.5% a year from now. Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki said that after the rare joint intervention, Tokyo and Washington remain aligned and are committed to keeping the FX market stable.

U.S. data remain mixed. August non‑farm payrolls added 162,000 jobs, about three times the market forecast, lifting the odds of a Fed rate hike next week to roughly 60%. Typically, higher U.S. rates widen the yield advantage of dollar assets, supporting USD/JPY. However, the dollar index fell on Tuesday to about 98.80, a two‑week low, as fiscal concerns and caution ahead of U.S. inflation releases dampen the dollar’s move.

What to watch now: U.S. producer‑price index (PPI) is due on Thursday, followed by consumer‑price index (CPI) on Friday. If the numbers come in high, they could push U.S. Treasury yields up and spark a strong dollar rebound even before the BOJ acts. Chart‑wise, ¥153 is the key near‑term pivot, with the next targets at ¥152 and the psychologically important ¥150. Resistance sits around ¥155, the level formed after the previous intervention. A sustained break below this zone would confirm a trend reversal; conversely, a higher‑than‑expected U.S. CPI could also revive yen bulls, as two central banks are currently jockeying for a more hawkish stance.

items.title: 楊金龍央行總裁生涯 第三度獲「A-」評比
items.title_en: Yang Jin‑long’s Central Bank Governor Career Earns “A‑” Rating for the Third Time
paras: 環球金融(Global Finance)雜誌公布2026 年央行總裁評比，台灣央行總裁楊金龍連續兩年拿下「A-」，也是楊金龍總裁生涯中第三度拿「A-」，楊金龍今(8)日對此回應，「謝謝大家，我會和央行同仁持續努力」。
A級評比有「A+」、「A」或「A-」，與央行同樣拿下「A-」有捷克、菲律賓、波蘭、瑞士、阿拉伯聯合大公國等主要國家。
而獲「A+」評比的僅丹麥、祕魯；「A」級名單有印度、新加坡、南非、智利等國。
環球金融自1994年起每年發布對近100個主要國家、地區等地的央行總裁評比，評分採「A+」至「F」的等級制，評估指標涵蓋通膨控制、經濟成長目標實現、貨幣穩定性、利率管理和政治獨立性等領域。
環球金融創辦人Joseph Giarraputo表示，央行總裁需要在持續的通膨壓力、不確定的成長前景和瞬息萬變的經濟情勢中運籌帷幄，又要維持市場信心，能獲得A級肯定的央行總裁都是具獨立性和審慎判斷力的領導者。
paras_en: Global Finance magazine released its 2026 central‑bank governor rankings, and Taiwan’s central bank governor Yang Jin‑long secured an “A‑” for the second consecutive year, marking the third time in his tenure he has earned an “A‑.” Yang said on the 8th that he thanks everyone and will continue to work hard together with his colleagues at the central bank.
The “A” tier includes “A+,” “A” and “A‑.” Other major economies that also received an “A‑” rating this year are the Czech Republic, the Philippines, Poland, Switzerland and the United Arab Emirates.
Only Denmark and Peru achieved the top “A+” rating, while the “A” list features India, Singapore, South Africa, Chile and others.

Since 1994, Global Finance has published annual rankings of central‑bank governors for roughly 100 major countries and regions, using a scale from “A+” down to “F.” The assessment criteria cover inflation control, achievement of economic‑growth targets, monetary stability, interest‑rate management and political independence.

Joseph Giarraputo, founder of Global Finance, said that central‑bank governors must navigate persistent inflation pressures, uncertain growth prospects and rapidly changing economic conditions while maintaining market confidence. Those who receive an “A” rating are leaders who demonstrate independence and prudent judgment.

items.title: 日元走強之下 10年期日債殖利率自高點回落
items.title_en: Yen Strength Pushes 10-Year Japanese Bond Yield Down from Peak
paras: 隨著日元匯率攀升至7個月新高，進口成本與通膨壓力降溫，日本10年期公債殖利率周二(8日)回落至約2.89%，延續了先前從30年高點回落的趨勢。
此前，日本10年期公債殖利率於9月1日一度攀升至3%大關，創下1996年以來的新高，相較於2025年8月已大漲超過1.4個百分點。
東京外匯市場上，美元兌日元周二一度下跌至1美元兌152日元區間，日元走強通常會降低進口成本，有助於抑制通膨。
這次波動的核心源於日本央行(BOJ)貨幣政策正常化的腳步。日銀於2026年6月將政策利率調升至1.0%。日銀審議委員高田創指出，未來不排除採取更大幅度或連續升息的可能性；日銀總裁植田和男也強調，決策者需密切留意物價上行的風險。
首相高市早苗的經濟顧問會田卓司表示，日銀很可能在9月再度升息，並於明年1月前再度調高利率；儘管他同時警告，加速升息可能會對經濟造成負擔。
與此同時，雖然日元走強，但市場分析指出，日元利差交易尚未真正全面平倉。根據《Fxstreet》分析，目前僅是日元融資成本被重新定價，利差交易持有的龐大部位依然續存。在日銀鷹派立場與高市政府擴張性財政政策帶來的債務付息壓力下，日本金融市場的變革仍將牽動全球資金流向。
paras_en: As the yen rose to a seven‑month high, import costs and inflation pressure eased, and Japan's 10‑year government bond yield fell on Tuesday (the 8th) to about 2.89%, continuing the decline from a three‑decade peak.

Earlier, the 10‑year Japanese government bond yield had briefly surged to the 3% mark on September 1, a new high not seen since 1996, representing an increase of more than 1.4 percentage points since August 2025.
In the Tokyo foreign‑exchange market, the dollar fell to the 152 yen per dollar range on Tuesday; a stronger yen usually lowers import costs and helps curb inflation.

The volatility stems from the Bank of Japan’s move toward policy normalization. The BOJ raised its policy rate to 1.0% in June 2026. Governor Takahiro Takata said larger or consecutive rate hikes cannot be ruled out, and Governor Kazuo Ueda stressed that policymakers must closely monitor upward price risks.

Prime Minister Sanae Kōchi’s economic adviser Takashi Aida said the BOJ is likely to raise rates again in September and lift them further before January 2027, though he warned that accelerating hikes could burden the economy.

At the same time, despite the yen’s strength, analysts note that yen carry‑trade positions have not been fully unwound. Fxstreet points out that only the financing cost of the yen has been re‑priced, while the large carry‑trade positions remain, and the BOJ’s hawkish stance combined with the expansionary fiscal policy of the Kōchi administration will keep debt‑service pressure shaping Japan’s financial markets and influencing global capital flows.
